name: Same-Safe
description: If another pile's top card matches this rank → Safe / If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed
notes: converts on a missed bet (any landing)

name: Guard
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card is safe when it lands. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Payout
description: At deal end if this card tops its pile → earn coins equal to pile size. / Any card played on top of this card is cursed
notes: cover punish curses the card played onto it

name: Bonus Coin
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 coin per pile whose top card matches. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Anchor
description: At deal end if this card tops its pile → exclude the pile from the smallest-pile score. / Any card played on top of this card is cursed

name: Heavy
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 pile size to every pile whose top matches, including this one. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Donate
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → make all pile sizes equal. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Quick Bury
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → bury 1 card under this pile. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Twin Spark
description: Peek at the next card if another pile's top card matches this rank

name: Pillar Scout
description: If this column has no Pillar → peek at the next card. / If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Base Scout
description: If this column has no Base → peek at the next card. / If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Ripple
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → optionally shuffle those piles. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Tell
description: If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card shows a tell (higher, lower, or same) for the next draw. / If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

name: Recharge Shield
description: If another pile's top card matches this rank → Charge Same Shield / If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed
notes: v6.90: rank conditional — converts on a miss

name: Tap Power
description: If another pile's top card matches this rank → Fire Same Power / If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed
notes: v6.90: rank conditional; fed bet + no power = quiet no-op

name: Heart Bounty
description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +1 coin

name: Column Tie-Safe
description: Any tie is safe in this column

name: Last Licks
description: At deal end → +3 coins if no pile in this column survived

name: Column Guardian
description: At deal end → +4 coins if every pile in this column survived

name: Envy
description: At deal end → +2 coins per pile in this column with a ♥ top card

name: Streak Size
description: From the 3rd consecutive correct guess in this column → +1 pile size per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

name: Streak Bury
description: From the 4th consecutive correct guess in this column → bury 1 card per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

name: Fourth Seat
description: This column starts the deal with 1 extra pile (up to 4)

name: Second Wind
description: Each pile that dies in this column has a 25% chance to be saved, but all the buried cards return to the deck

name: Greedy
description: At deal end → +4 coins if this is the only equipped pillar

name: Dense Bury
description: When a ♣ with 3+ stickers lands correctly in this column → bury 1 card under that pile

name: Revive
description: Revive a random dead pile in this column. Buried cards return to the deck

name: Flypaper
description: When a card lands correctly in this column → 5% chance it gains a random sticker

name: Underdog
description: When a {rank} lands correctly in this column → bury 1 deck card under that pile
notes: {rank} locked at first shelf: the scarcest

name: Crowd Favorite
description: When a {rank} lands correctly in this column → +2 coins

name: Insurance
description: At deal end → +8 coins if only one pile is alive

name: Ditto
description: Mirrors the center column's pillar

name: Heavy Diamond
description: ♦ cards in this column count as +2 toward pile size

name: Queen's Eye
description: When a royal ♠ (J/Q/K) lands in this column → peek at the next card

name: Royal Court
description: When a ♦ lands in this column → optionally shuffle the other piles in this column
notes: v6.91: offered, not forced — decline/tap-away keeps the order

name: Last Rites
description: When a pile in this column dies → peek the next card

name: Wild Aces
description: Aces count as high or low in this column

name: Diamond Anchor
description: At deal end → exclude any pile in this column with a ♦ top card from the smallest-pile score

name: Diamond Distribution
description: When a ♦ lands in this column → make all piles in this column equal size

name: Empty Ranks Bury
description: When a ♣ lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile per rank with zero copies in your full deck

name: Empty Ranks Coins
description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +2 coins per rank with zero copies in your full deck

name: Empty Ranks Heavy
description: When a ♦ lands in this column → +1 pile size per rank with zero copies in your full deck

name: Crazy Eights
description: If 8s are the most common rank in your full deck → this column's piles start at pile size 8

name: Royal Sanctuary
description: If your full deck contains no 2s → royals (J/Q/K) are always safe in this column

name: Majority Rule
description: If half or more of your full deck is {suit} → {suit} cards are safe when they land in this column

name: Diamond Echo
description: When a ♦ lands in this column → +1 pile size per duplicate of that card's rank in your full deck

name: Curse Ward
description: Stickers that would convert into curses in this column don't — they stay as stickers

name: Final Cut
description: Permanently purge whichever card kills the final pile in this column

name: Close Call
description: Same calls are safe on cards ±1 in value in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

name: Royal Pair
description: A royal landing on a royal survives a Same call in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

name: Same Suit Safe
description: A card landing on its own suit is safe in this column

name: Rank Shield
description: Most common card in deck ({rank}) is always safe in this column

name: Scarce Suit
description: The suit your deck holds the fewest of is safe when it lands in this column

name: Eight Ball
description: When an 8 lands in this column → peek at the next card

name: Pauper's Heart
description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♥ lands in this column, that pile gets a tell

name: Pauper's Diamond
description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → a ♦ landing anywhere on the board counts +2 toward pile size instead of +1

name: Pauper's Spade
description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♠ lands in this column, the next card shows a tell (higher/lower/same)

name: Pauper's Club
description: While your purse holds under 10 coins → when a ♣ lands in this column, bury 1 card under that pile

name: Curse Harvest
description: When a cursed card lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile, then peek at the next card

name: Size One Diamonds
description: While any pile in this column has pile size 1 → a ♦ landing anywhere on the board counts +2 toward pile size instead of +1

name: Bulk Rate
description: The store's Purge price climbs by 1 instead of 2. No effect during deal

name: Freebie
description: One random item in every store costs 0 coins. No effect during deal

name: Rare Hunter
description: Rare items appear in the store twice as often. No effect during deal

name: Bouncer
description: 30% chance to turn away a Just a Two mystery. 100% chance if there are no 2s in your deck. No effect during deal

name: Queen-Finder
description: +30% chance to find a Beheaded Queen at a mystery stop. 100% chance if Queens are the most common rank in your deck (ties don't count). No effect during deal

name: Flat Purge
description: On purchase → the store's Purge price is halved (minimum 5). No effect during deal

name: On the House
description: The first restock in each store and the first reshuffle of each deal are free
notes: HYBRID-lite: the free reshuffle is a deal-side perk

name: Rank Purge
description: On purchase → purge every {rank} from your deck. No effect during deal
notes: one-shot deck shaper at buy time

name: Kamikaze
description: Kill a random ♠-topped pile in this column, → peek the next 2 cards

name: Spade Peek
description: Peek the next card. Requires every pile in this column has a ♠ on top

name: Upheaval
description: Shuffle every pile in this column

name: Phoenix
description: Revive a random dead pile in this column. Buried cards return to the deck

name: Wild Sticker
description: Apply a random sticker to a random top card in this column

name: Ballast
description: Make ALL piles on the board equal size

name: Rank Setter
description: Permanently set every top card's rank in this column to the bottom pile's rank

name: Suit Setter
description: Permanently set every top card's suit in this column to the bottom pile's suit

name: Sticker Harvest
description: Choose a pile → bury 2 cards per sticker on its top card, then peel all those stickers

name: Refresh Bases
description: Recharge your other two bases

name: Club Dig
description: Bury 1 card under each ♣-topped pile in this column

name: Demolition
description: Destroy this column's pillar permanently, then peek the next 3 cards

name: Heart Demolition
description: Destroy every ♥-topped pile in this column. +4 coins per pile destroyed

name: Heart Tax
description: +1 coin per ♥ card in this column

name: Recharge Cell
description: Charge the Same Shield

name: Power Surge
description: Activate your Same-Power

name: Last Resort
description: In a non-boss deal, bury the whole deck under a pile in this column and win instantly. Any Base nearby is destroyed

name: Empty Purse
description: Spend ALL your coins → peek 1 card, +1 more per 10 coins spent

name: Same Sight
description: If the next card is the SAME rank as a top card anywhere on the board, the = mark appears on that card

name: Lone Peek
description: Peek the next card. Only works while no Same-Power is equipped

name: Club Oracle
description: Put a tell marker on each ♣-topped pile in this column for the next draw. Tell marker shows if the next card is higher, lower, or same

name: Escape Hatch
description: Only usable in an ambush from Just a Two → clear the deal instantly

name: Purge Coupon
description: Reduce the Store's Purge cost by 2 ({current} → {new}). Minimum 5
notes: occupies a base slot; −3 to Purge, floor 5

name: Bonus Reset
description: Reset bonus coins earned this deal to zero, then peek the next card

name: Sacrifice
description: Choose a pile → purge its top card from your deck, then kill that pile

name: Devil's Deal
description: Double your bonus coins earned this deal, then add a curse to a top card in this column

name: Cleanse
description: Remove all curses from the top cards in this column

name: Chorus
description: Set every top card in this column to {rank}

name: Diamond Boost
description: Every pile with a ♦ top card in this column → +3 pile size

name: Burrow
description: Bury 1 card under every pile with a {suit} top card

name: Rekindle
description: Revive a dead pile

name: Dividend
description: Gain 1 coin for each alive pile

name: Link Shuffler
description: Shuffle every alive pile

name: Cleanse All
description: When you call a correct Same → clear all curses from every top card on the board

name: Same Peeker
description: Peek the next card

name: Second Sight
description: Every alive pile shows a tell (higher/lower/same) for the next draw

name: Link Sticker
description: Apply a random sticker to every top card in this column

name: Long Odds
description: 50% chance to purge a card from the deck

name: Link Heavy
description: Add +1 pile size to every pile, and +3 to the pile you called Same on

description: When a ♣ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♣ → bury 1 deck card under the pile

description: When this card lands → bury 1 card under each pile whose top card matches this card's rank

name: Collector
description: +1 coin per other sticker on this card

name: Deep Pockets
description: +1 coin per 10 cards left in the deck

name: Heart Choir
description: +1 coin per each pile with a ♥ top card

name: Heart Snob
description: When a ♥ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♥ → +2 coins

name: Loose Change
description: +0–3 coins (random)

name: Compound
description: +X coins. X starts at 0, grows by 1 each correct placement, resets to 0 on a wrong guess

name: Spade Snob
description: When a ♠ lands on this card, or this card lands on a ♠ → peek at the next card

description: Peek at the next deck card

description: +2 pile size

description: When a ♠ lands in this column → 50% chance to peek at the next card
